how.title: From Figma to production in three steps

steps.title: Design in Figma
steps.detail: Brand, theme and component tokens live in Token Studio. A new brand is one file of values — components stay untouched.

steps.title: Sync to code
steps.detail: Tokens go to GitHub as JSON and compile into CSS custom properties. No hand-copied hex codes, no drift.

steps.title: Ship any brand
steps.detail: The product switches brand and theme with two attributes on the page. Same markup, same components, same release.
